scope: License-evidence closure for the Sun modality dataset before S2.4. This record does not authorize training, evaluation, formal use, publication, or redistribution.

springer_article.data_availability_paraphrase: The datasets are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; the notes also link the Archive.org item.

decision.reason: Public accessibility and a reasonable-request data-availability statement do not provide an explicit dataset license or written permission for model training and evaluation.
required_to_reopen: An explicit license whose text covers the dataset and permits the intended local model training and evaluation, or written permission from the authors/rightsholder covering those uses.
A separately recorded redistribution/publication grant before any raw or derived data are released; training permission alone must not imply redistribution permission.
A new exact-hash evidence record, contract update, negative tests, full offline audit, and experiment-provenance event before S2.4 ready may become true.
